name: White Dracolisk OLD

defensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Resistance
defensiveAbilities.description: A white dracolisk has resistance 10 to cold damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Petrifying Glance
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet that the dracolisk can see starts its turn

Effect The target must attempt a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save. If it fails, it becomes Slowed 1 for 1 minute as its body stiffens.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The white dracolisk breathes a 30ft Cone of energy. This breath weapon deals 6d10 Cold Damage damage, with a Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save.

The dracolisk can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dracolisk stares at a creature it can see within 30 feet. That creature must attempt a DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw save. If it fails and has not already been slowed by Petrifying Glance or this ability, it becomes Slowed 1. If the creature already was slowed by this ability or Petrifying Glance, a failed save causes the creature to be Petrified permanently.

A creature petrified in this manner can be instantly restored to flesh by being coated (not just splashed) with fresh dracolisk or basilisk blood no more than 1 hour old. A single dracolisk contains enough blood to coat 1d4+2 #medium creatures Medium creatures in this manner.

offensiveAbilities.name: Savage Jaws
offensiveAbilities.description: The dracolisk makes a single Strike with its jaws. If the attack hits, it deals (4d12+16) Piercing Damage damage (versatile S). This counts as two attacks for its multiple attack penalty.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Nature or Arcana, DC 26
